audit_scope: Every wake-word model artifact this repository ships, downloads, generates, or accepts from the user.

license_gate.note: The gate is asserted over the checked-in catalog, not evaluated at runtime. That is sufficient because the catalog is a source-code constant, but adding a runtime assertion in list_wake_models() would make the invariant self-defending.

repository_bundled_binaries.detail: No .onnx / .tflite / .npz / .pth / .safetensors artifact is tracked in this repository. Every wake model file arrives at runtime: downloaded from a pinned upstream URL, imported by the user, or trained locally.

excluded.name: openWakeWord pre-trained wake-phrase classifiers
excluded.verified_against: https://github.com/dscripka/openWakeWord README, "License of Pre-trained Models" section (retrieved 2026-07-15)
excluded.reason: Non-commercial. Fails the Apache-2.0 / CC0-1.0 / MIT gate. Not listed in AVAILABLE_WAKE_MODELS and not downloadable through the app.

excluded.name: openwakeword.com/library community models
excluded.reason: Per-model license metadata could not be verified programmatically (JS-rendered page, no accessible license field). Nothing from it is listed without verified license text.

user_supplied.integrity: SHA-256 recorded at import and re-verified on every load (wake_models.verify_imported_model); a digest mismatch quarantines the file and drops the manifest entry.
user_supplied.note: The user chose and supplied the file; the app states plainly that its licensing is the user's own responsibility and never redistributes it.

user_supplied.integrity: SHA-256 recorded at registration and re-verified on every load (same manifest and helpers as user-imported).
user_supplied.note: A local NumPy classifier head over the Apache-2.0 backbone. Positives come from the user's own recordings plus Kokoro-synthesized renderings; no third-party weights are incorporated, so there is nothing of anyone else's to redistribute.

training_inputs.role: Synthetic positive/negative audio for locally-trained wake phrases
training_inputs.distribution: pip dependency (kokoro, kokoro-onnx); weights fetched by that library, not by this repository
training_inputs.recorded_license_claim: Apache-2.0 / MIT (as stated in wake_trainer.py and wake_training_service.py)
training_inputs.note: Chosen specifically to avoid Piper (GPL), which openWakeWord uses for the same purpose. Independent verification of the Kokoro weights' license belongs to the TTS lane, not this wake audit — recorded here as an open item rather than asserted.

findings.summary: Zero wake model binaries are tracked in the repository; nothing unlicensed is bundled.

The catalog ships zero wake-phrase classifiers, so a fresh install has no phrase model. That is a deliberate license outcome, and audio_status.wake_status reports it as the distinct 'classifier_missing' state rather than a failure.
wake_models.ALLOWED_LICENSES is enforced only by a test over the checked-in catalog, never at runtime. A future catalog entry added without running the suite would not be refused by the code itself.

Kokoro's weights license is asserted in source comments but was not independently verified in this audit. It affects locally-trained models' provenance story, not anything this repository redistributes.
